name: clear
js: (() => { try { localStorage.clear(); } catch (e) {} location.reload(); return true; })()

name: closeSetup
js: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('setupDialog'); if (d && d.close) d.close(); return !!d; })()

name: before
js: (() => { const m = GMMC.getMap(); GMMC.setLayout('schematic'); GMMC.fit(); return [Object.keys(m.stations).length + ' stations', m.lines.length + ' lines', GMMC.getSettings().layout]; })()

name: run
js: (async () => { const t0 = performance.now(); const r = await GMMCSchematic.run({spacing: 2, keepShape: 0.3}); window.__r = r; const s = r.stats; return { runtimeMs: Math.round(performance.now() - t0), edges: s.edges, straightShare: +s.straightShare.toFixed(3), oneBendShare: +s.oneBendShare.toFixed(3), orderChanges: s.orderChanges, crossings: s.crossings, crossingsBefore: s.crossingsBefore }; })()

name: apply
js: (() => { const ok = GMMCSchematic.apply(window.__r); const m = GMMC.getMap(); return [ok, GMMC.getSettings().layout, Object.values(m.stations).every((s) => Number.isInteger(s.x) && Number.isInteger(s.y)), m.lines.some((l) => l.path.some((p) => p[0] === '@'))]; })()

name: undo
js: (() => { GMMC.undo(); const now = JSON.stringify(Object.values(GMMC.getMap().stations).map((s) => [s.id, s.x, s.y])); return now === window.__old; })()

name: redo
js: (() => { GMMC.redo(); const m = GMMC.getMap(); const p = window.__r.positions; return Object.values(m.stations).every((s) => s.x === p[s.id].x && s.y === p[s.id].y); })()

name: lang
js: (() => { const s = GMMC.getSettings(); s.lang = 'yue'; GMMC.saveSettings(); GMMC.applyI18n(); return [document.getElementById('schTitleT').textContent, document.getElementById('schPreview').textContent, document.getElementById('schOpen').textContent]; })()
